product_metadata.title: GreenPan Mayflower Pro Hard Anodized Healthy Ceramic Nonstick, 10" and 12" Frying Pan Skillet Set, Vintage Wood Handle, PFAS-Free, Induction, Charcoal Gray
features: Our Thermolon Minerals Pro healthy ceramic coating is metal utensil safe, heats evenly, and cleans up easily every time
Manufactured without the use of PFAS, PFOA, lead or cadmium—our cookware won’t release toxic fumes, even when overheated
A unique SearSmart Texture offers flavorful browning and easy release
Our Magneto Induction Base offers uniform heat distribution and sears and browns like a dream on all cooking surfaces: induction, gas, electric, halogen or ceramic
Duoforged Armored Bodies deliver extraordinary strength and scratch resistance
These pans will never warp or wobble over time (translation: more efficient browning, searing, and sautéing)
The carbonized ash wood handle makes a rustic touch and stays cool on the stovetop
Safe for all stovetops, including induction, not oven safe
description: Combining a rustic look with modern tech, this collection delivers cooking innovations in classic style. Mayflower features our SearSmart™ surface, a textured design that works with our signature healthy ceramic nonstick coating for better release, searing, and oil distribution. Both pans feature tough hard anodized bodies fitted with Magneto™ bases to maximize performance on all stovetops, including induction. Plus, the carbonized ash wood handles add a vintage contrast that stays cool. Not oven safe. Hand washing recommended.
